title: UW Markdown Section Block
description: JSON envelope inside a fenced ```json uw:section=... block in a .uw.md file. The block carries a section_id, provenance metadata (`_meta`), the section payload (`content`), and an optional free-text `_notes` annotation. Mirrors UWBlock + UWMeta in @uwmd/core/types.ts.

section_id.description: Section identifier. Standard sections use the IDs registered in UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4. Extension sections MUST start with 'x_'.

content.description: Section payload. Schema is per-section (see UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.x for each standard section). For extension sections (x_*) the content is unrestricted.

_notes.description: Free-text annotation. Never validated, never consumed by agents. See §3 universal field.

version.description: Monotonically increasing per supersede chain. New blocks for the same section get version = max(prev) + 1.

superseded.description: True when a later block has replaced this one. Pipeline_log entries omit this field — they are append-only.

source.description: Provenance tag matching one of the BUILTIN_EDIT_POLICIES patterns (e.g. 'manual', 'agent/L6-01', 'document/rent_roll', 'system/init', 'institution/threshold-override'). See protocol §V.3.

agent_id.description: REQUIRED when source matches 'agent/*'. Typically the layer ID (e.g. 'L6-01').

agent_version.description: Semver of the agent that produced the block, when source = agent/*.

actor.description: User identifier or system actor that initiated the write.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at write time.

input_hash.description: Reproducibility anchor: sha256 of the inputs used to produce content. Null if not applicable.

partial.description: Optional. True when at least one field inside the block is missing or unknown. When true, field_overrides SHOULD enumerate which paths and why. See format spec Part III §3.

provisional.description: Optional. True when the entire block is a placeholder derived from defaults rather than observed data. Stronger than confidence:'low'.

field_overrides.description: Optional. Per-field overrides where block-level confidence/source does not apply uniformly.

path.description: Dot-notated path relative to the block content root (e.g. 'units[7].current_rent').

content_hash.description: Optional. sha256 of the canonicalized block content (RFC 8785 JCS minus _meta.content_hash and _meta.signature). See protocol §IX.2.

parent_hash.description: Optional. content_hash of the block this one supersedes; null on a chain root. If any block in a supersede chain has it, all later blocks in that chain MUST.

signature.description: Optional. Detached signature over the block's signing input (protocol §V.11, RFC 0010). Requires content_hash: a signature with no hash beside it commits to nothing (INT-05).

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Closed set for protocol 1.x. ECDSA signatures are raw r||s (IEEE P1363), not DER.

kid.description: Opaque key identifier the verifier resolves in its own key store. Key distribution is out of scope.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 instant the signature was produced. MAY differ from _meta.timestamp.
